definitions.explanation: insufficient in quantity or quality; in short supply

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}が{乏|とぼ}しい。
{資源|しげん}が{乏|とぼ}しい{国|くに}だ。
examples.english: It's a country poor in resources.

examples.japanese: {知識|ちしき}が{乏|とぼ}しいため{説明|せつめい}が{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to explain because I lack knowledge.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}は{乏|とぼ}しいが、{幸|しあわ}せだ。
examples.english: Life is meager, but I'm happy.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}が{乏|とぼ}しいので{新|あたら}しい{設備|せつび}を{買|か}えない。
examples.english: We can't buy new equipment because the budget is scarce.

notes:
PATTERN:
- Xが{乏|とぼ}しい (lacking in X)
- Xに{乏|とぼ}しい (poor in X)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経験|けいけん}が{乏|とぼ}しい (lack experience)
- {資源|しげん}が{乏|とぼ}しい (scarce in resources)
- {知識|ちしき}が{乏|とぼ}しい (lacking knowledge)
- {資金|しきん}が{乏|とぼ}しい (short of funds)
- {語彙|ごい}が{乏|とぼ}しい (limited vocabulary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {少|すく}ない: few, little (more neutral)
- {足|た}りない: not enough, insufficient
- {欠|か}けている: lacking, missing

OPPOSITE:
- {豊|ゆた}か (abundant, rich)
- {豊富|ほうふ} (plentiful)
